description: The Supreme Court - Notice appointing 15.10.2018 as effective date for the Rule 1 of the Court of Appeal Rules - 2018
reasoning: This gazette content announces the coming into force of the Court of Appeal (Appellate Procedure) Rules - 2018, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It involves the publication of court procedural rules, a notification by the Chief Justice, and the appointment of an effective date for these legal rules. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and legal procedures for the court system.
